runtime_verification: Extracted the downloaded public release ZIP, verified its SHA-256 and every file against published PROVENANCE.json, and checked manifest version 1.1.14. Runtime files were not modified.
environment: Cloud Linux desktop; isolated new English profile; native keyboard/mouse interaction and screenshots only.
capture_method: Original native CUA window screenshot bytes in browser fullscreen mode; Chrome for Testing notice and bottom browser bar retained. No headless browser, debugging socket, injected JavaScript or rendered mockup.
transforms: None. No cropping, resizing, redrawing, recompression or pixel edits.
sample_data: Five built-in example sites created by clicking Create Starter Set through the normal new-tab UI. Default English category names retained. No personal data or signed-in account.
network_scope: Automatic release checks, online favicon fetching and Chrome Sync were left at their off defaults. Drive was not connected. No release check, web search or example-site visit was triggered. Browser background networking was not measured.
ui_observations: Both Go to settings export and Go to Countdown export controls and their navigation-only explanation are visible.
Automatic checks are unchecked, with Not checked saved results.
The English categories Work, Social, Entertainment, Tools and Learning are visible in the dark new-tab screenshot.
limits: This is a bounded documentation capture pass, not a complete feature, theme or locale regression run.
The backup navigation controls are shown; their destination/keyboard validation is recorded separately in docs/upgrade-backup-navigation-validation.md.
Existing README galleries are historical captures from their documented revisions.
The desktop clock differs from orchestration UTC; its displayed time was not altered.
cleanup: Owned screenshot Chrome window closed through native UI. Pre-existing Chromium and file-manager windows were preserved.
